sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_stage_snapshots AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
), 
latest_market_data AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM market.equity_eod
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod)
), 
insider_bulk_data AS (
    SELECT ia.symbol, ia.alert_date, bb.deal_date, ia.qty, bb.qty AS bulk_qty, ia.value_cr, bb.price
    FROM signals.insider_alerts ia
    JOIN latest_stage_snapshots lss ON ia.symbol = lss.symbol
    JOIN signals.bulk_block_deals bb ON ia.symbol = bb.symbol
    WHERE ia.alert_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days'
)
SELECT *
FROM insider_bulk_data
LIMIT 50;
